subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this issue remain open as a coordination tracker, or should maintainers split its remaining evidence between the broad placeholder tracker and the incomplete-turn replay-safety tracker?
rationale: The item is valid, but source review shows multiple remaining roots and no single canonical issue cleanly owns the provider/media, exec-warning, and incomplete-turn pieces together.

options.title: Split Evidence To Existing Trackers
options.body: Move or link the provider placeholder evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99241 and the payloads=0/tool-error policy evidence to the replay-safety tracker, then close this issue when that routing is explicit.

options.title: Keep This As Coordination
options.body: Keep this issue open until the active provider/media PRs and incomplete-turn policy work are both resolved, accepting duplicate tracking cost.

options.title: Close To Broad Placeholder Tracker Now
options.body: Close this as a duplicate of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99241, but risk losing the exec-warning and incomplete-turn details unless they are copied first.

recommendation.title: Split Evidence To Existing Trackers
recommendation.body: Move or link the provider placeholder evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99241 and the payloads=0/tool-error policy evidence to the replay-safety tracker, then close this issue when that routing is explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the adjacent empty post-tool final-turn recovery and are the strongest single routing candidate for the replay-safety policy side of this mixed issue.
